info.title: RESET Store REST API
info.description: Contract-first API for RESET Store (Unified Website Project backend serving Blade, Filament v3 Admin, and Mobile Project Flutter Client). Monetary *_cents fields store base Cambodian Riel (KHR ៛) integers.

BearerAuth.description: SHA-256 hashed API Bearer token issued by /api/v1/auth/login or /api/v1/auth/register.

CartToken.name: X-Cart-Token
CartToken.description: Stateless guest cart token mapped to carts.session_id.

OrderToken.name: X-Order-Token
OrderToken.description: Stateless HMAC-SHA256 guest order token issued by POST /api/v1/checkout.
